description: This file defines the entity class 'BuzzPost' for a social/posting feature within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes properties for post content, timestamps, and related photos and links, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database mapping.

classes.name: BuzzPost
classes.description: Entity class representing a social media post within the OrangeHRM system, with ORM mappings for database persistence, associated with an employee, containing text, timestamps, photos, and links.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the post.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the post.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the employee associated with this post.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this post.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Gets the text content of the post.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the post.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Retrieves the creation timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to the current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Retrieves the last updated timestamp in UTC, if any.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Updates the last modified timestamp to the current UTC time.
